summary: PR #143 is a substantial substrate buildout (401k additions, 1,515 audit-grade artifacts, 33 µservice directories present). Local `oya gate run-all` PASSES 52/52 lanes — verified independently. However, the PR is BLOCKED for merge due to (1) GitHub CI cargo-fmt FAILURE, (2) GitHub CI cargo-nextest FAILURE, and (3) ADR-number collision: two ADR-0130-*.md files exist in docs/decisions/. The 6-Foundry-to-1 consolidation cites real hyperscaler product perimeters (AWS Bedrock / Vertex AI / Azure AI Foundry / Anthropic Console / Palantir AIP / LangSmith) with public-doc URLs and is verified. Cedar/Kustomize duplication claim (Sweep-J no-op) is verified — per-µservice policy schemas are genuinely distinct, not extractable. Foundry supervisor kill-switch artifacts (IPs 023/024 + runbook + catalog rows + capability + dashboard) are all present. Several claims are overconfident or unverified: Loro 1.x scoping, Cedar v4.2 LTS designation, OpenBao 2.x maturity, and the hyperscaler INV metric emission (documented contract but no crate emits the metrics yet — the PromQL will scrape NULL). The PR-body claim '1,005 placeholders eliminated' contradicts the gate output showing 1,081 open placeholders registered. VERDICT: BLOCK until CI green + ADR-0130 collision resolved. The substrate work itself is sound and the verified-evidence base is strong; the remaining blockers are mechanical.
